name: DatePicker

props.name: allowInput
props.description: Flatpickr prop passthrough enables direct date input, and when set to false, we must clear dates manually by resetting the value prop to an empty value (such as `""`, `null`, or `undefined`) or an array of all empty values, making it a controlled input.

props.name: appendTo
props.description: The DOM element the flatpickr should be inserted into `<body>` by default.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: flatpickr prop passthrough. Controls whether the calendar dropdown closes upon selection.

props.name: dateFormat
props.description: The date format.

props.name: datePickerType
props.description: The type of the date picker: * `simple` - Without calendar dropdown. * `single` - With calendar dropdown and single date. * `range` - With calendar dropdown and a date range.

props.name: disable
props.description: The flatpickr `disable` option that allows a user to disable certain dates.

props.name: enable
props.description: The flatpickr `enable` option that allows a user to enable certain dates.

props.name: inline
props.description: The flatpickr `inline` option.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether or not the control is invalid (Fluid only)

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language locale used to format the days of the week, months, and numbers. The full list of supported locales can be found here https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr/tree/master/src/l10n

props.name: maxDate
props.description: The maximum date that a user can pick to.

props.name: minDate
props.description: The minimum date that a user can start picking from.

props.name: nextMonthAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible aria-label for the "next month" arrow icon.

props.name: parseDate
props.description: flatpickr prop passthrough. Controls how dates are parsed.

props.name: prevMonthAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible aria-label for the "previous month" arrow icon.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: whether the DatePicker is to be readOnly if boolean applies to all inputs if array applies to each input in order

props.name: short
props.description: `true` to use the short version.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the date value provided to flatpickr, could be a date, a date number, a date string, an array of dates.

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state (Fluid only)

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon DatePicker rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
